body: Part 1 done: RamsterZ FBX sources are in METRES (proven by hip-to-head raw=0.68m, a realistic human measurement). The old /100 was Cascadeur's cm-to-m conversion applied to metre sources - the x10 mismatch Q162 noticed. Source hip-to-hip raw=3.18m (not 0.0318m). The Att and Vic are separate FBX files with independent coordinate origins (3.18m apart for 5 of 7 pairs). The retargeting pipeline discards horizontal position so the origin gate was comparing apples to oranges. Engine note: FightClipRetarget.gd line 1206 has the same /100 bug for the contact solve path.
